lyrics:
[Intro: low growling guitar, slow heavy drum]

[Verse 1: low, controlled female voice, simmering]
Somewhere across town there's a booth and a candle
A girl who thinks his jokes are more than she can handle
He's got his best shirt on and his phone face down
He's about to have a real bad night in this town

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, voice rising]
'Cause I didn't key a thing, I didn't break a glass
I just sat down at the laptop and I did the math

[Chorus: full-voiced belt, big guitars]
I changed every password, every single one
The movies and the music and the fantasy league he runs
The thermostat, the doorbell, the miles on his card
Named the Wi-Fi "Ask Your Girlfriend," bless his heart
He can knock, he can call, he can guess till it's light
I changed every password tonight

[Verse 2: low again, enjoying it]
He'll go to pay the check and his card won't clear
He'll go to call a ride and the app won't hear
He'll walk three miles in his good suede shoes
Working on a story that I won't excuse

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, voice rising]
I didn't burn his clothes, I didn't make a scene
I let two-factor authentication do it for me

[Chorus: full-voiced belt, big guitars]
I changed every password, every single one
The movies and the music and the fantasy league he runs
The thermostat, the doorbell, the miles on his card
Named the Wi-Fi "Ask Your Girlfriend," bless his heart
He can knock, he can call, he can guess till it's light
I changed every password tonight

[Bridge: half-time, a growl that climbs]
First pet's name? I changed it. Mother's maiden? Gone.
Favorite teacher? Street he grew up on?
The answer to every question, from here on in
Is the name of a girl he won't see again

[Final Chorus: highest belt, held note on the last word]
I changed every password, every single one
The movies and the music and the fantasy league he runs
The thermostat, the doorbell, the miles on his card
Named the Wi-Fi "Ask Your Girlfriend," bless his heart
He can knock, he can call, he can guess till it's light
I changed every password tonight

[Outro: guitar growl, a login error chime]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 74 BPM with a heavy backbeat, 4/4, F# minor. Slow, dark and swaggering.

VOICE: Female, a big country-rock voice. Verses are low, controlled and amused; pre-choruses climb; choruses are full belts with a rasp on the top notes. The bridge starts as a growl and rises. One long held note ends the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A low, gritty electric guitar riff, a second guitar with slide, heavy live drums, bass, a fiddle playing dark answering lines, organ under the choruses.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro riff. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:40 Pre-chorus. 0:52 Chorus 1. 1:22 Verse 2. 1:50 Pre-chorus. 2:02 Chorus 2. 2:32 Bridge, half-time. 2:50 Final chorus, held note. 3:14 Outro, an error chime at 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2000s country-rock: thick guitars, big drums, the voice huge and upfront.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Named the Wi-Fi "Ask Your Girlfriend," bless his heart' at 1:06.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original takes a bat to a truck. Twenty years later the way to ruin someone's night is a keyboard, it is legal, and she walks away without a scratch on anything.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Cold anger, relish, triumph, gone.
